**Unique Value Proposition:** Full turnkey projects — appraisal, consulting, sale, transport, and rigging all under one roof  
**Reputation:** 50-year trusted, family-owned brand serving aerospace, defense, and manufacturing industries

- Facility consolidations

---

## **4. DIFFERENTIATORS**

- 50+ years in business with strong reputation  
- Family-owned and operated  
- Full turnkey management from appraisal to install  
- Trusted by major industrial clients (Volkswagen, ABB, Ball Aerospace)  
- National network of rigging and logistics partners  

---

## **5. LINKEDIN OUTREACH SEQUENCE**

**Goal:** Engage plant and operations leaders about surplus machinery or upcoming replacements.

**Message 1 – Initial:**  
> Hey {{first_name}}, noticed your facility works in {{industry}} — are you currently running any equipment scheduled for decommission or upgrade this quarter?  
> My team at Opincar Machinery specializes in turnkey asset removal, appraisals, and resale for CNC and heavy equipment.  
> Worth a quick chat?

**Message 2 – Follow-Up (2–3 days later):**  
> Following up here — we just helped a client in {{state}} move out a CNC boring mill and free up 4,000 sq ft of production space.  
> We handle appraisal, sale, and removal under one roof. Do you currently have any machines sitting idle or scheduled for replacement?

**Message 3 – Follow-Up (5–7 days later):**  
> Totally understand things get busy.  
> Quick question — are you the right person to contact for surplus equipment and asset disposition? If not, who on your team handles that?

---

## **6. INSTANTLY / APOLLO OUTREACH SETUP**

**List Name:** “Industrial Machinery Sellers — Opincar Outreach”  
**Job Titles:** Owner, General Manager, Plant Manager, Maintenance Manager, Operations Manager  
**Industry Tags:** Aerospace, Rail, Defense, Power Generation, Paper Mills, Manufacturing  
**Employee Count:** 50+  
**Geography:** US only — TX, OK, MO, PA, TN, FL, AL, OH  
**Buyer Intent Keywords:** “surplus machinery,” “machinery liquidation,” “CNC removal,” “plant shutdown,” “asset appraisal,” “turnkey install”  
**Goal:** 20 qualified seller opportunities per quarter  

---

## **7. BOT OUTREACH & AI SDR LOGIC TREE**

**Objective:** Identify sellers of CNC and heavy industrial machinery (primary) and buyers for turnkey projects (secondary).  

**Step 1 – Initial Message:**  
> Hi {{first_name}}, noticed your facility works in {{industry}}. Are you currently running any CNC or heavy equipment scheduled for decommission, upgrade, or relocation?  
> We help companies appraise, remove, and resell large-scale machine tools — including CNC boring mills, lathes, and machining centers.

**Step 2 – Qualification Prompts:**  
1. What type of machine(s) are you looking to sell?  
2. Do you know the make, model, or spindle size?  
3. Is the equipment operational or stored?  
4. Timeline for removal or sale?  
5. Prefer direct sale, brokerage, or consignment?  
6. City or facility location?

**Step 3 – Routing Logic:**  
| Lead Type | Signal | Action |
|------------|---------|--------|
| Seller | Mentions selling or clearing space | Mark as “Qualified Seller” |
| Buyer | Mentions needing new equipment | Route to sales consultation |
| Future | Mentions “next quarter” or “planning” | Add to 45-day re-engagement |
| Unqualified | No ownership authority | Suppress from campaign |

**Step 4 – Tone & Cadence:**  
- Voice: Professional, confident, concise  
- Follow-up: Every 2–3 business days (max 3 before human review)  

---

## **8. TECHNICAL QUALIFIERS (FOR SDR & CRM)**

| Category | Data Points to Capture |
|-----------|------------------------|
| Machine Specs | Spindle size, HP, control type, model, serial, travels |
| Condition | Operational / Non-op / Refurbished |
| Ownership | Owned / Consigned / Brokered |
| Location | City, State, Facility Size |
| Transport | Rigging / Removal / Turnkey |
| Urgency | Immediate / 30 days / Planning |

---

## **9. MACHINE SPECIFICATION QUESTIONNAIRE**

**CNC Horizontal Boring Mill (HBM-T / HBM-F)**  
- Manufacturer / Model / Year  
- Spindle Diameter & Taper  
- X, Y, Z, W Travels  
- Table Size, RPM, HP  
- Control Type & Axes  
- Accessories: DRO, Facing Head, Tailstock, Rotary Table, Coolant  

**CNC Vertical Boring Mill (VBM / CNC-VBM)**  
- Table Diameter & Swing  
- Table RPM, HP, Control Type  
- Rail Travel, Ram Type, Stroke  
- Face Plate or Chuck Size  

**CNC Lathe (L2150 Series)**  
- Swing Over Bed / Cross Slide / Gap  
- Bed Length, Spindle Bore, Chuck Size  
- HP, RPM, Control, Tool Turret, Threading Type  

**Engine Lathe (L3000 Series)**  
- Swing × Bed Length  
- Chuck Size, HP, RPM, Tailstock, Threading  

**Machining Centers (VMC / HMC)**  
- Table Size (X×Y)  
- Axis Travels (X, Y, Z)  
- Spindle RPM, HP, Taper, Tool Capacity  
- Control Type & Pallet Count  

**Cylinder, Rotary & Surface Grinders / Milling Machines**  
- Swing Diameter, Wheel Size, HP, Feed Type, Coolant System  
- Table Size, Travel, Speed, and Feed Controls  

---

## **10. DISCOVERY & QUALIFICATION QUESTIONS**

**Information Gathering:**  
- What prompted your company to sell or upgrade equipment?  
- What are your goals for the process?  
- How did you determine your current machinery needs?  
- Have you worked with brokers before?  

**Qualifying:**  
- Timeline for removal or sale?  
- Preferred pricing method or range?  
- Who else is involved in the decision?  

**Rapport Building:**  
- How long have you been with the company?  
- What types of projects are most important right now?  
- What do you value most in a sales partner?
